create_qwen3moe_model: create a Qwen3MoE causal language model with config and quantization config for inference
build_qwen3moe_decoder_layer: build a Qwen3MoE decoder layer with attention, MoE MLP, and layer normalization components
run_qwen3moe_forward: run a forward pass on the Qwen3MoE model with input_ids, positions, and forward batch info
load_qwen3moe_weights: load HuggingFace-compatible weights into a Qwen3MoE model with expert parallel and tensor parallel support
test_qwen3moe_attention: test the Qwen3MoE attention module with QKV projection, RMSNorm, RoPE embeddings, and RadixAttention
